protocol.intent: Descriptive bounded GPU comparison of eager and compiled executions; no selection or claim that the retained strict parity gate passed.
protocol.selection_rule: first observations in trajectory order, including only the first horizon observations per trajectory
protocol.batch_rule: PCG64 offline_batches sampler with replacement; identical rows in both executions
protocol.state_rule: separate paths advance from identical initialized states; compare raw target, loss, parameter, optimizer, target-network, and action differences
protocol.common_state_rule: compare eager and jitted Bellman target calculations at the same eager state, RNG, and minibatch on every update
protocol.counter_rng_rule: check exact counters and RNG values each update
protocol.finite_rule: report nonfinite values and fail diagnostic if encountered
protocol.interpretation: Raw descriptive differences only; no post-observation equivalence threshold. Previously failed strict parity remains failed.
